How UP Nexus works

Type straight into the quick-add box, e.g. Send report tomorrow 15:00 !1 #work

todayDue today — tomorrow works too friNext Friday (any weekday name) 15:00Time of day !1Priority — 1 high, 2 medium, 3 low #workDrop it in that list

Calendar

dragDrag empty space in week/day view to create an event moveDrag an event up/down to reschedule, left/right to change day resizeDrag its bottom edge to change the duration

Shortcuts

NNew task ENew event HNew habit FStart / pause the focus timer TJump back to today 1Calendar — month 2Calendar — week 3Calendar — day ← →Previous / next period /Search ?This screen EscClose a dialog / clear the search

• Data is stored in this browser only — clearing browsing data wipes it, so export a .json backup.
• Editing or deleting a repeating event applies to the whole series.
• Reminders only fire while the app tab is open.
• This is a personal log, not a medical or financial advice tool.
